    ncode CLI / Get started

    Install

    Install with one line. It needs macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon (arm64).

    Install#

    sh
    curl -fsSL https://code.llmotions.com/install.sh | sh

    Note Nothing is installed system-wide.

    Check the install#

    CommandPrints
    ncode --versionncode 0.1.0
    a | ba pipe inside code

    Press Ctrl+C twice to quit. This is bold, this is italic, and a literal {{cmd}}.

    ╭─ ncode ─────────╮
│ ready           │
╰─────────────────╯

    Uninstall#

    1. Run the uninstaller:

      sh
      curl -fsSL https://code.llmotions.com/install.sh | sh -s -- --uninstall
    2. Keep or remove ~/Library/Application Support/SwarmCode.

    Uninstall#

    The second heading with the same text gets a numbered id.

    Approval modes#

    Three modes per project: read-only, auto and full access. A dangerous command always asks.
